lines.z-ai/glm-5.3-prime: The top reasoning tier of Z.ai's GLM 5.3 line, above the Flash and FlashX cuts.
lines.sakana/fugu-max: Sakana AI's largest Fugu tier. Takes text, images and files, returns text.
lines.google/gemini-embedding-2: Text, images, video, audio and PDFs in one 3,072-dimension vector space.
lines.upstage/solar-mini4: Upstage's small, fast tier in the Solar 4 generation. Text only.

headline: GLM 5.3 Prime and Fugu Max join with 1M windows, plus Gemini Embedding 2
share: GLM 5.3 Prime and Sakana's Fugu Max are now on AnyRouter, both with 1M-token context. Also new: Google's multimodal Gemini Embedding 2 and Upstage's Solar Mini 4 with a 524K window.
rationale: Seven models were new on 2026-09-28 (the other five in this record were already filmed in 001). Two are flagship tiers from known labs with 1M windows, so they lead; Google's first multimodal embedding model is the third story; Solar Mini 4 shows the cheap end with a long window. Span-01 Lite (a free classifier), Hy-MT2 (8K translation) and Qwen3 Embedding 4B are smaller cuts and would crowd four cards.
